scope: Raw presentation JSONL pages only; not model history, authorization, Evidence, or streaming-sidecar admission.
cursor: Exclusive byte start of the oldest inspected record, bound to conversationId and exact sourceRevision; external writes invalidate it.
corruption: Return an invalid_json row with source byte range rather than silently dropping it.
limits: Bound records, scanned bytes, single record bytes and aggregate decoded nodes/strings/bytes. Oversized records return an explicit error and scanned source range.
